inventory.alt: Imagined scene: Bread and water await guests beside an open door. A green path leads toward distant hills.
inventory.textBasis: 1:5-8 praises care for traveling brothers and strangers and urges support for their journey. Bread, a water jug and an open door form an imagined hospitality motif; no meal, exact house, route or completed face-to-face meeting is claimed. Does not literalize children (1:4), conflate Gaius or Demetrius with same-named people elsewhere, or portray Diotrephes as welcoming guests.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Native 960x540: bread crust/scoring and plate rim/contact; jug lip, neck, body, handle joins and table contact; table and bench planks/legs; folded red cloth weave/fringe; hanging cloth; door boards/braces/fasteners/ring; threshold/floor/mat weave; left basket lid/handle and partial pot; niche basket and two pots, foliage and landscape/path. No definite malformed object, lettering or signature. Occluded supports, jug contents, exact date/site, botanical species and bread recipe are not established.
